import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 32;
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static class Matrix {
        int[][] a = new int[maxn][maxn];

        void clear() {
            for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < maxn; j++) {
                    a[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void output() {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                    System.out.print(a[i][j] + (j == n + 1 ? "\n" : " "));
                }
            }
            System.out.println();
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix rhs) {
            Matrix B = new Matrix();
            B.clear();
            for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= n + 1; k++) {
                        add(B.a[i][j], (long) a[i][k] * rhs.a[k][j] % mod);
                    }
                }
            }
            return B;
        }
    }

    static void add(int x[], int y) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= mod) x[0] -= mod;
    }

    static void add(int x, int y) {
        // For single integers, not used in this code
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextInt();

        Matrix E = new Matrix();
        E.clear();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            E.a[i][i] = 1;
        }

        Matrix ans = new Matrix();
        ans.a = copyMatrix(E.a);
        Matrix[] A = new Matrix[maxn];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            A[i] = new Matrix();
            A[i].a = copyMatrix(E.a);
            A[i].a[i][i] = 1;
        }

        Matrix[] pre = new Matrix[n + 2];
        Matrix[] suf = new Matrix[n + 2];
        pre[0] = new Matrix();
        pre[0].clear();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            pre[i] = new Matrix();
            pre[i] = multiplyMatrices(pre[i - 1], A[i]);
        }
        suf[n + 1] = new Matrix();
        suf[n + 1].clear();
        for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
            suf[i] = new Matrix();
            suf[i] = multiplyMatrices(A[i], suf[i + 1]);
        }

        while (m > 0) {
            long u = m % n;
            if (u != 0) {
                long s = 0;
                for (long v = m / n; v > 0; v /= n) {
                    s = (s + v % n) % n;
                }
                u = (s + u - 1) % n + 1;
                for (; u != s; u--) {
                    if (u <= 0) u += n;
                    ans = A[(int) u].multiply(ans);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                pre[i] = multiplyMatrices(pre[i - 1], A[i]);
            }
            for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
                suf[i] = multiplyMatrices(A[i], suf[i + 1]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                A[i] = multiplyMatrices(suf[i], pre[i - 1]);
            }
            m /= n;
        }

        int num = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            add(new int[]{num}, ans.a[n + 1][i]);
        }
        System.out.println(num);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int[][] copyMatrix(int[][] src) {
        int[][] dest = new int[maxn][maxn];
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(src[i], 0, dest[i], 0, maxn);
        }
        return dest;
    }

    static Matrix multiplyMatrices(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
        Matrix res = new Matrix();
        res.clear();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n + 1; k++) {
                    add(res.a[i][j], (long) a.a[i][k] * b.a[k][j] % mod);
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
}
